title: Whole-system scalar pullback interchange commutes with shifts
statement: Fix a prime l, finite extensions E,L of Q_l and an inclusion $\iota$ : E $\to$ L. For any morphism f : X $\to$ Y of schemes, give exact whole-system pullbacks and universal whole-system scalar extension [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems] the shifts of [def-sf-integral-comparison-canonical-shifts]. The generator- and universal-counit-normalized scalar/pullback isomorphism integralComparisonSystemScalarPullback then commutes with every integer shift on the derived category of the whole strict quotient system.

proof.text: Construct the two cochain computations using exact pullback localization factors and the universal scalar counits. The ordinary associator is degree zero, so its termwise extension commutes with shifts, and hence both cochain computations commute with shifts.

proof.text: On a K-flat P the defining normalization identifies the two computations after the derived associator. P[m] is K-flat too. The target scalar counit is invertible on P; compare the two computation squares and cancel that counit to obtain the derived associator square on Q(P).

lean.statement:
theorem integralComparisonSystemScalarPullback_commShift
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra ℚ_[l] L] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] L]
    (ι : E →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] L) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    letI := integralComparisonSequencePullbackShift l E f
    letI := integralComparisonSequencePullbackShift l L f
    letI := integralComparisonSequenceScalarShift l E L ι X
    letI := integralComparisonSequenceScalarShift l E L ι Y
    NatTrans.CommShift (integralComparisonSystemScalarPullback l E L ι f).hom ℤ
